scope: Primary sources used to delimit currently proved low-rank MTC classification results. This ledger does not claim that all ribbon realizations of ranks 5 through 7 are classified.

references.title: On Classification of Modular Tensor Categories

locators.claim: All unitary MTCs of rank at most 4 are classified; there are 35 up to ribbon tensor equivalence.
The unitary rank-at-most-4 fusion families are listed.
Standard unitary quantum-group categories of rank at most 12 are listed, but this is not a classification beyond rank 4.

references.title: On Classification of Modular Categories by Rank

locators.claim: Every rank-5 modular category is Grothendieck equivalent to SU(2)_4, PSU(2)_9, SU(5)_1, or PSU(3)_4.
The theorem classifies fusion rules; the number of distinct modular categories on the underlying fusion categories is not known.

references.title: On the Classification of Weakly Integral Modular Categories

locators.claim: Weakly integral modular categories through rank 7 are Deligne products of pointed, Ising, and metaplectic categories.
For a modular category, the universal grading group is isomorphic to the group of invertible simple objects.
Weakly integral rank-6 categories are Ising times cyclic rank 2, metaplectic SO(5)_2 type, or cyclic rank 6.
The only strictly weakly integral rank-7 categories are metaplectic.

Odd-N metaplectic categories arise by gauging particle-hole symmetry of cyclic categories; if N has s distinct odd prime factors, there are exactly 2^(s+1) inequivalent metaplectic modular categories.

references.title: Classification of Rank 6 Modular Categories with Galois Group <(012)(345)>

locators.claim: A particular rank-6 Galois case is classified up to modular data; this is not a classification of all rank-6 MTCs up to ribbon equivalence.
